templates.name: Fix Grammar & Spelling
templates.description: Corrects grammar, spelling, and punctuation without changing tone or meaning.
templates.prependText: Fix the grammar, spelling, and punctuation in the following text. Keep the tone and meaning exactly the same. Respond with only the corrected text, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: Works well with any Q4_K_M instruct model, even 1-3B.

templates.name: Improve Writing
templates.description: Improves clarity and flow while preserving the original meaning.
templates.prependText: Improve the clarity and flow of the following text. Preserve the original meaning and the author's voice as much as possible. Respond with only the improved text, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: A 3B+ model gives noticeably better results than 1B for this one.

templates.name: Make More Formal
templates.description: Rewrites casual text in a professional, formal tone — e.g. for a business email.
templates.prependText: Rewrite the following text in a more formal, professional tone, suitable for a business email. Keep the core meaning unchanged. Respond with only the rewritten text, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: Works well with any Q4_K_M instruct model, even 1-3B.

templates.name: Make More Casual
templates.description: Rewrites formal text in a relaxed, conversational tone.
templates.prependText: Rewrite the following text in a more casual, conversational tone, as if talking to a friend. Keep the core meaning unchanged. Respond with only the rewritten text, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: Works well with any Q4_K_M instruct model, even 1-3B.

templates.name: Make Concise
templates.description: Shortens the text while keeping the key meaning intact.
templates.prependText: Make the following text more concise. Remove redundant words and filler without losing any key information. Respond with only the shortened text, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: Works well with any Q4_K_M instruct model, even 1-3B.

templates.name: Expand & Elaborate
templates.description: Adds detail and explanation to a short note or outline.
templates.prependText: Expand the following text with more detail and explanation, while staying consistent with what's already written. Respond with only the expanded text, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: A 3B+ model gives more coherent, less repetitive results than 1B for this one.

templates.name: Summarize
templates.description: Condenses a long passage down to its key points.
templates.prependText: Summarize the following text, capturing only the key points. Respond with only the summary, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: Works well with any Q4_K_M instruct model, even 1-3B.

templates.name: Convert to Bullet Points
templates.description: Reformats prose into a clear bullet-point list.
templates.prependText: Convert the following text into a clear, well-organized bullet-point list. Respond with only the bullet points, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: Works well with any Q4_K_M instruct model, even 1-3B.

templates.name: Explain Simply
templates.description: Rewrites jargon-heavy or complex text in plain, simple language.
templates.prependText: Rewrite the following text in plain, simple language that a non-expert could easily understand. Avoid jargon. Respond with only the rewritten text, no explanations.
templates.recommendedModelHint: A 3B+ model handles this better than 1B — simplifying well requires some reasoning.
